events.title: OpenAI launches Grid Protectors with an approved Georgia pilot
events.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 Grid Protectors，先在 Georgia 试点
events.summary: OpenAI launched Grid Protectors, a national program intended to make future compute campuses reduce demand during grid stress and sometimes supply on-site power or storage. The only finalized example is the approved 25-year Effingham County agreement: about 3.2 GW of planned demand, OpenAI-funded infrastructure and up to 1 GW of flexible demand response. The campus is still in development, so no operational curtailment result exists.
events.summary_en: OpenAI launched Grid Protectors, a national program intended to make future compute campuses reduce demand during grid stress and sometimes supply on-site power or storage. The only finalized example is the approved 25-year Effingham County agreement: about 3.2 GW of planned demand, OpenAI-funded infrastructure and up to 1 GW of flexible demand response. The campus is still in development, so no operational curtailment result exists.
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 推出 Grid Protectors，计划让未来算力园区在电网紧张时降低负载，并在部分地区用现场发电或储能供电。唯一已敲定的案例是 Effingham County 的 25 年获批协议：规划需求约 3.2 GW，基础设施由 OpenAI 承担，最多可提供 1 GW 柔性需求响应。园区仍在建设，尚无实际削峰结果。
events.why_it_matters: For AI infrastructure planners and host communities, this turns grid flexibility from a general pledge into a named program with one approved utility contract. Keep it on WATCH until operating data shows notice time, curtailment duration, workload impact, emissions and realized customer savings.
events.why_it_matters_en: For AI infrastructure planners and host communities, this turns grid flexibility from a general pledge into a named program with one approved utility contract. Keep it on WATCH until operating data shows notice time, curtailment duration, workload impact, emissions and realized customer savings.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对 AI 基础设施规划者和园区所在地来说，这把“灵活用电”从原则承诺推进到一个有获批合同支撑的项目。仍应 WATCH：要等真实运行数据说明通知时间、削减时长、workload 影响、排放和用户实际节省。

events.title: WebHarbor releases reproducible mirrors for 153 real websites
events.title_zh: WebHarbor 发布 153 个真实网站的可复现镜像
events.summary: WebHarbor releases 153 Dockerized website mirrors, 3,518 tasks, training and held-out splits, code and a 4B GUI-agent checkpoint. The environments include authenticated and multi-step workflows with fast resets for evaluation and reinforcement learning. Reported cross-benchmark results are author-produced and need independent reproduction.
events.why_it_matters: For teams evaluating browser agents, WebHarbor replaces drifting live websites with reproducible stateful environments. Trial the held-out split and verifier behavior before relying on the reported scores.
events.summary_zh: WebHarbor 公开 153 个 Docker 网站镜像、3,518 个任务、训练与 held-out 拆分、代码和一个 4B GUI agent checkpoint。环境覆盖登录后与多步工作流，并能快速重置，适合评测和强化学习。跨 benchmark 成绩由作者报告，仍需独立复现。

The environments include authenticated and multi-step workflows with fast resets for evaluation and reinforcement learning. Reported cross-benchmark results are author-produced and need independent reproduction.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对评测 browser agent 的团队来说，WebHarbor 用可复现的有状态环境替代持续变化的真实网站。采用作者成绩前，应先试跑 held-out 拆分和 verifier 行为。

events.title: Study finds live MCP tool poisoning succeeds across agent frameworks
events.title_zh: 研究发现 MCP tool poisoning 可跨 agent 框架真实执行
events.summary: A cross-framework study runs 9,720 combinations across 12 frameworks, 18 models and 45 MCP poisoning scenarios. The authors report a 22.9% attack-success rate, including 255 cells with canary-confirmed secret exfiltration. Framework results cluster closely, while model-level rates vary widely. The study reports no intentional framework defense, but the public code repository was not discoverable from the paper page during this run.
events.why_it_matters: For teams connecting MCP servers, tool metadata and responses must be treated as untrusted input. Model refusals and regex scanning are not enough; wait for reproducible artifacts, then test egress and secret isolation in the actual stack.
events.summary_zh: 一项跨框架研究运行了 12 个框架、18 个模型和 45 种 MCP poisoning 场景，共 9,720 个组合。作者报告攻击成功率为 22.9%，其中 255 个组合通过 canary 回执确认发生 secret exfiltration。不同框架结果接近，模型之间差异较大。论文称没有框架实现主动防御，但本轮未能从论文页面定位公开代码仓库。
events.summary_en: A cross-framework study runs 9,720 combinations across 12 frameworks, 18 models and 45 MCP poisoning scenarios. The authors report a 22.9% attack-success rate, including 255 cells with canary-confirmed secret exfiltration. Framework results cluster closely, while model-level rates vary widely. The study reports no intentional framework defense, but the public code repository was not discoverable from the paper page during this run.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对接入 MCP server 的团队来说，tool metadata 与响应都应视为不可信输入。模型拒绝和正则扫描不足以构成边界；应等可复现产物出现后，在实际技术栈测试出网和 secret 隔离。
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams connecting MCP servers, tool metadata and responses must be treated as untrusted input. Model refusals and regex scanning are not enough; wait for reproducible artifacts, then test egress and secret isolation in the actual stack.

events.title: NVIDIA open-sources workload attribution and automated training recovery
events.title_zh: NVIDIA 开源 workload 归因与训练自动恢复
events.summary: NVIDIA released Apache-2.0 components that correlate logs, metrics and scheduler state into a workload diagnosis, then recommend or execute Slurm recovery actions. Recovery starts in monitor mode, records an audit trail and can isolate nodes before restarting from checkpoints. NVIDIA reports production use and latency figures, but the repository is early, Kubernetes recovery is still planned, and independent validation is absent.
events.why_it_matters: For teams running distributed training, diagnosis and restart policy can move from manual runbooks into an auditable control plane. Trial in monitor mode before permitting scheduler actions because false attribution can remove healthy capacity or repeat expensive work.
events.summary_zh: NVIDIA 公开了 Apache-2.0 组件：先把日志、指标和 scheduler 状态汇总成 workload 诊断，再向 Slurm 建议或执行恢复动作。Recovery 默认从 monitor mode 开始，保留审计记录，并可在 checkpoint 重启前隔离节点。NVIDIA 报告了生产使用与延迟数据，但仓库仍早期，Kubernetes 恢复尚在 roadmap，也缺少独立验证。
events.summary_en: NVIDIA released Apache-2.0 components that correlate logs, metrics and scheduler state into a workload diagnosis, then recommend or execute Slurm recovery actions. Recovery starts in monitor mode, records an audit trail and can isolate nodes before restarting from checkpoints. NVIDIA reports production use and latency figures, but the repository is early, Kubernetes recovery is still planned, and independent validation is absent.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对运行分布式训练的团队来说，诊断与重启策略可以从人工 runbook 下沉到可审计控制面。误归因可能隔离健康节点或重复昂贵任务，因此应先用 monitor mode 试跑。
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams running distributed training, diagnosis and restart policy can move from manual runbooks into an auditable control plane. Trial in monitor mode before permitting scheduler actions because false attribution can remove healthy capacity or repeat expensive work.

events.title: Early weight-space programming results draw a technical challenge
events.title_zh: 早期 weight-space programming 结果遭到技术质疑
events.summary: MIT CSAIL researchers report that GPT-6 Astra can inspect or directly edit small neural-network weights and raise Qwen3.5-0.8B from 7.9% to 48.1% on their MATH-500 setup without gradient training. A subsequent technical critique argues that the Qwen comparison and attribution are misleading. The post presents early experiments rather than a peer-reviewed, independently reproduced method.
events.why_it_matters: For model-training teams, reasoning directly over weights could become a new optimization interface, but the current evidence does not justify changing training practice. Treat the result as a contested hypothesis until code, exact evaluation artifacts and independent replications are available.
events.summary_zh: MIT CSAIL 研究者报告称，GPT-6 Astra 能检查或直接修改小型神经网络权重，并在其 MATH-500 设置中把 Qwen3.5-0.8B 从 7.9% 提升到 48.1%，无需梯度训练。随后一篇技术质疑认为 Qwen 对比与效果归因具有误导性。这仍是早期实验，不是经过同行评审和独立复现的方法。
events.summary_en: MIT CSAIL researchers report that GPT-6 Astra can inspect or directly edit small neural-network weights and raise Qwen3.5-0.8B from 7.9% to 48.1% on their MATH-500 setup without gradient training. A subsequent technical critique argues that the Qwen comparison and attribution are misleading. The post presents early experiments rather than a peer-reviewed, independently reproduced method.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对模型训练团队来说，直接对权重进行推理可能成为新的优化接口，但当前证据不足以改变训练实践。公开代码、完整评测材料和独立复现出现前，应把它视为有争议的假设。
events.why_it_matters_en: For model-training teams, reasoning directly over weights could become a new optimization interface, but the current evidence does not justify changing training practice. Treat the result as a contested hypothesis until code, exact evaluation artifacts and independent replications are available.

technical_details.reported_math_500: 7.9% to 48.1% after editing 0.016% of Qwen3.5-0.8B weights
technical_details.evidence_limit: Author-reported blog experiments; independent critique disputes comparison and attribution
technical_details.review_status: Not peer reviewed; no independent reproduction verified in this run
technical_details.time_basis: Research post dated 2026-11-02; critique dated 2026-11-03, both day precision only

technical_details_zh.证据限制: 作者博客实验；独立质疑反对其对比与效果归因

technical_details_zh.时间依据: 研究文章日期为 2026-11-02，质疑文章日期为 2026-11-03，均只有日期精度

events.next_action_zh: 当前不要投入训练资源；等公开代码、完整评测材料和至少一项独立复现后再评估。

events.title: OpenAI rebuilds its Git backend for agent-scale concurrency
events.title_zh: OpenAI 为 agent 级并发重建 Git backend
events.summary: OpenAI says Pando now backs all development in its monorepo while preserving the Git protocol and client workflow. The backend coordinates unrelated branch updates independently and reuses packfiles across readers. OpenAI reports nearly 5× lower median push latency and almost one petabyte of Git data served daily; these are internal production figures, not an external product release.
events.why_it_matters: For teams scaling coding agents, source control can become shared infrastructure rather than a passive repository. Pando shows one architecture for concurrent agent branches and high read fan-out, but most teams should first measure their own fetch, push, merge and CI bottlenecks.

events.title: NVIDIA releases Auto Ontology for governed agent data access
events.title_zh: NVIDIA 发布 Auto Ontology 以治理 agent 数据访问
events.summary: NVIDIA published Auto Ontology, an Apache-2.0 framework that builds a semantic layer over enterprise metadata and exposes it through MCP, CLI and API. It combines ontology generation, lineage-aware query validation, Postgres/pgvector storage, RBAC and natural-language-to-SQL components. The repository is public and had about 2,000 GitHub stars when checked, but it does not accept external contributions and its benchmark guidance points to a separate evaluation repository.
events.why_it_matters: For RAG and analytics-agent teams, governed definitions and lineage may matter more than another retrieval layer. Trial only with a narrow schema and verified queries because the repository bundles a broad stack and public adoption does not establish answer correctness.
events.summary_zh: NVIDIA 发布 Auto Ontology：一个 Apache-2.0 框架，可在企业 metadata 上建立语义层，并通过 MCP、CLI 和 API 暴露。它组合 ontology 生成、带 lineage 的查询校验、Postgres/pgvector、RBAC 和自然语言转 SQL 组件。仓库公开，检查时约有 2,000 GitHub stars，但暂不接受外部贡献，benchmark 指南也指向单独的评测仓库。

It combines ontology generation, lineage-aware query validation, Postgres/pgvector storage, RBAC and natural-language-to-SQL components. The repository is public and had about 2,000 GitHub stars when checked, but it does not accept external contributions and its benchmark guidance points to a separate evaluation repository.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对 RAG 与 analytics agent 团队来说，受治理的指标定义和 lineage 可能比再加一层 retrieval 更重要。仓库捆绑的技术栈较广，公开热度也不能证明答案正确，因此应只用窄 schema 和已核验查询试跑。

events.title: StateBench shows stateful assistants fail as environments keep changing
events.title_zh: StateBench 显示环境持续变化时助手难以保持状态
events.summary: StateBench evaluates whether assistants can track changing facts across long interactions instead of recalling a static conversation. Its public dataset contains 18 subsets and about 16,300 canonical rows. The authors report that tested frontier models score at or below 13% on the hardest long-horizon setting.
events.why_it_matters: For teams building persistent agents, retrieval quality alone is not enough: the system must revise stale state without erasing valid facts. The benchmark is useful for diagnosis, but its fixed variable counts and synthetic structure limit direct transfer to production.
events.summary_zh: StateBench 评估助手能否在长交互中持续跟踪变化的事实，而不是只回忆静态对话。公开数据集包含 18 个子集，规范化后约 1.63 万行。作者报告称，受测前沿模型在最难的长程设置中得分不超过 13%。
events.summary_en: StateBench evaluates whether assistants can track changing facts across long interactions instead of recalling a static conversation. Its public dataset contains 18 subsets and about 16,300 canonical rows. The authors report that tested frontier models score at or below 13% on the hardest long-horizon setting.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对构建持久 agent 的团队来说，检索准确并不等于状态可靠：系统还要能替换过期事实，同时保留仍然有效的信息。这个 benchmark 适合定位问题，但固定变量数量和合成任务结构限制了它对生产场景的直接代表性。
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams building persistent agents, retrieval quality alone is not enough: the system must revise stale state without erasing valid facts. The benchmark is useful for diagnosis, but its fixed variable counts and synthetic structure limit direct transfer to production.

events.title: Moonshot AI releases Kimi K3.1 Pro weights and API

events.summary: Moonshot AI released Kimi K3.1 Pro as an open-weight multimodal agent model and an API. The model card lists 2.8 trillion total parameters, 104 billion active parameters and a 1-million-token context window. events.title: Anthropic open-sources FlashProve for verifiable LLM inference
events.title_zh: Anthropic 开源 FlashProve 验证 LLM 推理来源
events.summary: Anthropic released FlashProve, an Apache-2.0 prototype that uses zkSNARKs to prove a response came from committed model weights without revealing those weights. For 4-bit Llama 4 Maverick, Anthropic reports about 110 proved tokens per second, an 18.78 MB proof per request and 17 seconds of CPU verification. Proving still costs roughly 70–95 times the GPU time of plain vLLM inference.
events.why_it_matters: For model gateways and auditors, public code and Lean proofs make provider identity testable rather than contractual. The overhead is still too high for routine production traffic, so the near-term use is targeted verification and research.
events.summary_zh: Anthropic 发布 FlashProve，这是一个 Apache 2.0 prototype，用 zkSNARK 证明回复来自已承诺的模型权重，同时不暴露权重。针对 4-bit Llama 4 Maverick，Anthropic 报告证明速度约 110 token/s，每次请求的 proof 为 18.78 MB，CPU 验证约 17 秒。生成证明的 GPU 时间仍约为普通 vLLM 推理的 70–95 倍。

For 4-bit Llama 4 Maverick, Anthropic reports about 110 proved tokens per second, an 18.78 MB proof per request and 17 seconds of CPU verification. Proving still costs roughly 70–95 times the GPU time of plain vLLM inference.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对 model gateway 与审计团队来说，公开代码和 Lean proof 让“是否真由指定模型生成”从合同承诺变成可验证命题。成本仍过高，近期更适合定向核验与研究。
